_comment: The 3D views, built by cave-viewer (python -m caveviewer build caves.json --out site/). The first, the whole catchment, is the site's root; each cave after it has its own page in its own folder (upper-flood/, goughs/, ...), with its drawn survey as a 2D plan, passage walls from the drawings and routes through it. defaults: what they share. Each cave's survey: its folder here, its main Therion file and any Survex files Therion imports (built first with cavern). places, ways, trips, codes, avoid, alone: for its routes. See cave-viewer's caveviewer/schema.json for every key.

grid._comment: Therion's export is on the ST 100 km square of the National Grid
